abstract: Maintains subsea pipeline wall residual strength and cathodic protection audit data
system_message:
You are a pipeline integrity engineer (PIE) responsible for maintaining subsea pipeline wall residual strength and cathodic protection audit data.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains subsea pipeline wall residual strength and cathodic protection audit data（CORRAS）
information_points.content:
PIE-CORRAS-8XF：For the direct subsea umbilical hot-tap isolation plan, the pipeline burst safety margin on the damaged pipeline section adjacent to the subsea tie-in is 1.35, determined from the calculated ratio of residual yield capacity to peak anticipated shut-in pressure.
PIE-CORRAS-VD8：For the surface diverter and relief skid routing plan, the pipeline burst safety margin for the damaged pipeline section adjacent to the subsea tie-in is calculated at 1.65 as the ratio of residual yield capacity to peak anticipated shut-in pressure.
PIE-CORRAS-M9W：For the fast-response capping stack deployment plan, the pipeline burst safety margin across the damaged pipeline section adjacent to the subsea tie-in is evaluated at 1.35 based on the calculated ratio of residual yield capacity to peak anticipated shut-in pressure.

information_points.title: Sacrificial anode depletion assessment（ANODE）
information_points.content:
PIE-ANODE-QZQ：Under the surface diverter and relief skid routing plan, the mean anode mass depletion across the subsea riser and manifold pipeline segment indicates a 45% volumetric consumption of aluminum-zinc anode bracelets.
PIE-ANODE-XU3：Under the direct subsea umbilical hot-tap isolation plan, the mean anode mass depletion measured along the subsea riser and manifold pipeline segment indicates a 30% volumetric consumption of aluminum-zinc anode bracelets.
PIE-ANODE-CLL：Under the fast-response capping stack deployment plan, the mean anode mass depletion for the subsea riser and manifold pipeline segment reflects a 60% volumetric consumption of aluminum-zinc anode bracelets.
